Native text-span evidence replaces PDF-reader span types.

extraChanges.subject: Native image lifecycle preservation
extraChanges.note: Selected images retain original slide labels and bounded batch sequence metadata. Snapshot/render paths share timeout/cancellation handling. Finite bleed content is composed locally and clipped at the slide viewport.

extraChanges.subject: Options capture
extraChanges.note: Internal load/save snapshots preserve explicit password assignment, binary import limits and security policies without adding public serialization helpers.

extraChanges.subject: Read-only inspection and preservation types use Info
extraChanges.note: Phase A naming follows the approved rule that read-only snapshots end in Info. Geometry properties remain unchanged for Phase B.

Specialized static content-safety, provenance and signature inspection entry points are internal native kernels. OfficeDocument.Inspect(path, OfficeInspectOptions) returns OfficeDocumentInfo with selectable typed reports and optional native content. IncludeContent=false preserves inspection without content extraction; original package/signature/provenance guards and explicit provider selection remain in their owning libraries. Provenance takes an independent options snapshot with caller cancellation.

Group Drawing projection retains the prior export behavior for authored shape and connector outline widths. Encrypted native saves distinguish unset save settings from explicit password removal and retain exact encrypted source bytes when no change is requested. Legacy projection guards run before encryption admission for all path and stream overloads.

Native raster export uses Core raster conventions already used by the prior PDF page-image route. The shared raster owner applies whole-pixel baseline snapping to upright text lines as well as positioned text; existing visual baselines remain the acceptance oracle.

Native slide image diagnostics retain invalid-shape-bounds for invalid frames and untransformed shapes entirely outside the visible slide. Finite bleed rendering continues through the existing clipped Drawing scene; no PDF dependency is reintroduced.

Presentation image export shares one embedded-image budget across selected slides and retains presentation conversion findings on every page result. Text inspection uses shared rich-line leading for plain frames with padding. Independent PDF and Drawing geometry is compared at PDF precision; SVG XML validity and existing raster baselines remain checked. Legacy preserve-only loss classification and picture-bullet checks use mapped diagnostic identifiers. Unsupported native charts retain unsupported-chart.
Repeated legacy PPT saves retain the effective destination password, explicit password removal and encryption profile rather than restoring the original source settings.

Bubble-chart export tests exercise authored colors in independently decoded native and PDF raster/SVG outputs. Cross-engine encoded-byte equality is removed because the format package now renders with Core instead of the PDF engine; native geometry and raster regressions keep their dedicated coverage.

PowerPointDeckPlan.AddContent and PowerPointContentPlanSlide pass public typed layout blocks to the existing Compose engine. PowerPointLayout selects automatic or explicit composition; composition results include every physical continuation slide.
